title: Her first European trip: the 1962 blues festival
summary: In 1962 she went to Europe on a blues festival with T-Bone Walker, Memphis Slim and Willie Dixon. She notes she does not sing the blues constantly, and a Swedish pianist backed her very well.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan
